verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Cline providing a sandbox or test environment that keeps agent actions away from production data. Plan mode is a read-only dry-run, not sandbox isolation. Kanban's isolated git worktrees and checkpoints/undo separate or revert code changes, which is adjacent to this story but does not isolate execution from production data or systems.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
